name: UniqueOpcodes
comment: Single-byte opcodes with mask 0xFF — irregular instructions that don't fit any cc-pattern: BRK + the 'official' single-byte NOP. Other discrete instructions (transfers, flags, stack ops, branches) live in their own group files for organisation.

formats.name: Brk
formats.comment: 0x00 — BRK (force interrupt). Pushes PC+2 + status (with B flag set), sets I flag, jumps to IRQ vector ($FFFE).

formats.name: Nop
formats.comment: 0xEA — official 1-byte NOP. Other 'unofficial' NOPs (1, 2, 3-byte variants) live in unofficial.json.
